proposed_widenings.name: ModifyRollAdvantageOperation (new OngoingOperation variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Foresight grants the target advantage on all D20 Tests for the duration. OngoingOperation only offers roll_modifier (numeric DiceDelta) and damage_on_hit. No variant can express advantage/disadvantage as an ongoing spell operation. The v4 atom modify_roll_advantage exists but is unreachable from OngoingOperation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has Advantage on D20 Tests

proposed_widenings.name: "ability_check" in RollKind
proposed_widenings.justification: D20 Tests in SRD 5.2.1 covers attack rolls, saving throws, AND ability checks. RollKind only has 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw'. Foresight's advantage applies to all three categories; RollKind must be widened.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has Advantage on D20 Tests

proposed_widenings.name: Incoming roll modifier scope for OngoingOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: Foresight imposes disadvantage on attack rolls made BY OTHER CREATURES against the target. No current OngoingOperation variant expresses this 'incoming' scope — all existing modifiers act on rolls made by the target or caster, not rolls made targeting the creature. A new operation variant (e.g., impose_roll_disadvantage_on_incoming) or a scope discriminant on a combined advantage operation is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against it

notes: Casting time (1 minute, ritual=false), range (touch), and duration (timed 8 hours) all map cleanly to existing surface types. The blocking gaps are purely in OngoingOperation: no advantage/disadvantage variant exists, RollKind omits ability checks, and there is no 'incoming' roll-modifier scope. The v4 atom modify_roll_advantage covers both effects conceptually; the surface just cannot invoke it from a spell operation. Forcing roll_modifier would misrepresent the mechanic. Secondary omission: 'spell ends early if you cast it again' maps to the v4 lifecycle atom replace_on_recast but the Duration type has no self-expiry-on-recast variant — recorded but not the primary block.
